invariants.rationale: The method assumes profile is used to access partition paths and workload statistics, so it should not be null.
The method uses context to retrieve small files for partitions and thus requires it to be non-null.
The method immediately assigns profile.getPartitionPaths() to a Set and iterates over it, implying it must not be null.
The method performs logic per partition path; it is meaningful to expect that there is at least one partition path.
For each partition path, profile.getWorkloadStat(p) is used; it should not be null for correct downstream usage.
